title: Confirm the rule for an attendee's copy of the organisers' notice
summary: Confirm the conductor's rule for taking an attendee's copy of the organisers' email or app notice: (a) only from the person who received it, by their own choice; (b) sent to a person (you), never straight into the repository; (c) labelled evidence, "an attendee's copy of the organisers' notice", with the time received and a short excerpt in our words, no sender or recipient details, the copy kept in a private vault with its hash; (d) never the source of the headline or of a fact: a public primary page stays the source.
blocks: Contribute's task C-04 asks only for the time and what changed until you confirm; no copy of a notice is taken.
closes: Your yes, your changes, or your no.
